headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: n8n documentation spans 1,300 pages with 100% crawl coverage and zero confirmed broken links. Critical weaknesses exist in AI retrieval readiness (overall score 37.61/100, 'weak' band) driven by 8.69% chunkability and 0% answerability. Only 41.25% of 1,772 detected claims include supporting evidence, and 50% of pages lack actionable guidance. SEO/geo issues affect 25.85% of pages, while API reference coverage reaches 77.78% across 117 detected pages. Example code reliability shows 0% (likely a detection limitation due to JS rendering), and overall audit confidence stands at 63.5%.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

key_findings.headline: Missing required doc layers
key_findings.business_consequence: Backfill concept/how-to/reference coverage for key capabilities.

priority_actions.title: Refactor the 91% of pages with poor chunkability (1,183 pages) to use semantic headings, shorter sections, and explicit topic boundaries for vector search and LLM context windows
priority_actions.why_this_first: Directly unlocks AI-assisted support, in-product help, and RAG quality for 1,183 pages, reducing ticket volume and accelerating user self-service in 30 days.

priority_actions.title: Add inline evidence (screenshots, logs, output examples, error messages) to the 1,041 claims currently lacking support (58.75% of 1,772 claims) across high-traffic onboarding and troubleshooting pages
priority_actions.why_this_first: Builds trust and reduces 'does this actually work?' friction for new users, directly shortening time-to-first-workflow and improving trial conversion.

priority_actions.title: Convert the 50% of pages lacking actionable guidance (650 pages) into step-by-step procedures with clear next actions, especially for integration setup and workflow creation
priority_actions.why_this_first: Reduces support tickets and onboarding drop-off by giving users clear 'what to do next' paths, improving activation metrics within the trial window.

strengths: Complete crawl coverage (1,300 of 1,301 pages, 100%) with no broken internal or repository navigation links
Strong API reference coverage at 77.78% across 117 detected API pages
100% last-updated metadata coverage and 100% citationability for attribution
risks: AI retrieval readiness overall score of 37.61/100 ('weak') severely limits LLM answer quality and RAG performance
Chunkability at 8.69% means 91% of pages will fragment poorly for vector search and context windows
Answerability at 0% indicates pages lack self-contained Q&A structure, forcing users to navigate multiple pages
Only 41.25% of 1,772 claims (731 total) include evidence, undermining trust and onboarding for new users
limitations: External audit cannot verify actual user comprehension, task completion rates, or support ticket correlation with specific documentation gaps
Example reliability at 0% is flagged as a likely detection limitation due to JavaScript-rendered code blocks; manual sampling required to confirm real code quality
Chunkability and answerability scoring reflects structural heuristics, not real-world LLM retrieval performance with n8n's specific user queries and context
automation_first: Deploy a pre-commit linter to enforce semantic heading hierarchy and section length limits (target <300 words per section) on all markdown files, addressing the 8.69% chunkability crisis across 1,183 pages and preventing future regressions that degrade RAG and AI answer quality.

Implement a CI check that flags any claim-heavy page (>5 assertions) missing evidence patterns (code blocks, image references, log snippets) to systematically close the 58.75% evidence gap (1,041 unsupported claims) and ensure new content includes trust-building proof.

Add automated SEO validation (missing meta descriptions, title length, heading structure) to the build pipeline to catch and fix the 25.85% SEO/geo issue rate (336 pages) at authoring time, improving search ranking and reducing manual audits.
